purpose: Long-form legal document layout: sticky TOC rail + rich-text column. Shared shape between /privacy-policy and /terms.

responsive.desktop: 12-col-equivalent grid, 400px/712px columns, gap 120px, left rail sticky.

tablet.change: flex column, gap 32px; left rail no longer sticky.

mobile.change: gap 24px on left rail; rich-wrapper padding reduces to 24px (16px horizontal at 390px).

contentPolicy: The body prose is REPRESENTATIVE PLACEHOLDER TEXT, not real legal copy. A visible in-page notice (role="note", warning-colored) is REQUIRED and must render above the body prose — verified actually present and rendered in both src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.jsx:161-173 and src/pages/Terms.jsx:132-141, not merely claimed. A generated instance of this section must always include and render `placeholderNotice` visibly; omitting it is a compliance regression, not a cosmetic simplification.

motion.pattern: fd-fade on the notice banner only
